hiddenInfoSafetyReview.notes: Corp node/asset semantics remain Corp-side until rezzed, accessed, exposed or otherwise legally known. Access ambush exceptions are documented as report-only semantics.
AI026 adds no WebSocket, reconnect, undo-preview, replay, PublicEvents, log, client-error, planner or Targeting-AI projection path.

deferredItems.rationale: Hidden installed-card choices, run redirect, self-counter spending, private HQ/R&D manipulation and access-triggered counters remain report-only until side-safe TargetProfile schema support exists.
AI026 introduces no generic Corp node, asset, advertisement, transactions, AI, ambush, virus or random strategy. Anchors use existing strategy IDs only when function evidence supports them.
